text: Just 3 minutes in, Jonah Lindqvist scored for Ironvale Athletic, putting them 1-0 up against Redmond Rovers. This chance was decent, with a 0.345 xG value, meaning it’s a shot that’s scored about 3 or 4 times in 10 attempts. Ironvale’s strong counter-attacking style caught the home side’s high defensive line off guard right from the start[#40][#45][#50].
